description: Questions with the flow the decider is expected to choose. lookup = read the best passages; exact = answered from the metadata by SQL; unsupported = a kind of request the system cannot do yet and must say so; survey = a question about the practice, the kinds of cases or the outcomes across many documents that it does not name (not built yet: said plainly). A case has either 'question' or 'golden_id' (the text is then taken from questions.json). Used by `corpus/cli.py routing-eval`, which runs the real decider (the planner and the scope), no retrieval and no answer.

cases.note: pinpoint: a case number, asks about that case
pinpoint: a case number, asks about that case
pinpoint: a case number, asks who represents a party
kinds and outcomes of reviews across a court and a year, picked by topic
practice over a period across many cases of a topic: nothing is named

adversarial: an invented case number must lead to a read that finds nothing, not to a filter that matches nothing
